webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.subtitle: Send events to other systems, and receive theirs.
webhooks.newText: Choose the events to send and where to send them. The signing secret is shown once, after saving.
webhooks.allWorkspacesHint: Send events from all workspaces, not only the current one.

payload.minimal: Minimal: event, record type and id

webhooks.payloadHint: Minimal is safer: the receiver asks the API for details with its own permissions.
webhooks.fullUnavailable: Some of the chosen events can't carry the full record.

secret.title: Signing secret
secret.once: Copy it now. It is shown only once.
secret.rotateConfirm: The old secret keeps working for 24 hours.

webhooks.deleteText: Deliveries not sent yet are given up. This can't be undone.

errors.urlRequired: Enter the address to send to.
errors.url_refused: This address can't be called. Internal addresses need an entry in WEBHOOKS_ALLOWED_HOSTS.
errors.scheme: Only http and https addresses can be called.
errors.unresolvable: This host can't be found. Check the address.
errors.blocked_address: This is an internal address. Add it to WEBHOOKS_ALLOWED_HOSTS to allow it.

incoming.newText: Pick what to do with what arrives and how to check it comes from the sender. The secret is shown once, after saving.
incoming.urlHint: Give this address to the sender. It accepts POST requests checked with the secret.
incoming.headerPrefixHint: The sender signs with X-{prefix}-Signature (its WEBHOOKS_HEADER_PREFIX).
incoming.signaturePrefixHint: Text before the digest, if any.
incoming.timestampHeaderHint: When set, the digest covers the timestamp, a dot and the body, and the timestamp must be under 5 minutes old.
incoming.deliveryHeaderHint: Names each delivery, so a repeat is refused. Without one, a repeated body is.
incoming.tokenHeaderHint: The header that carries the secret. Empty: X-Webhook-Token.
incoming.allowedIpsHint: One address or CIDR per line. Empty: any address.
incoming.secretInputHint: Paste the sender's secret, or leave empty to generate one
incoming.secretText: Give it to the sender, unless you pasted theirs.
incoming.allWorkspacesHint: Not tied to a workspace: its handler runs outside any workspace.
incoming.rotateConfirm: The old secret keeps working for 24 hours. Give the new one to the sender.
incoming.deleteText: Its URL stops accepting requests at once. This can't be undone.

errors.unknownHandler: This handler is no longer installed. Choose another.
errors.signatureHeaderRequired: Name the header that carries the signature.
errors.allowedIps: Each line must be an IP address or a CIDR range.
